chunks: He said: Abu Ghalib Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Zurari, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me, saying: My uncle Ali ibn Sulaiman narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisi narrated to us, saying: al-Ala' ibn Razin narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Muslim al-Thaqafi, who said: I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, saying:

There is no religion for one who adheres to obeying those who disobey God, and there is no religion for one who adheres to inventing falsehood against God, and there is no religion for one who adheres to repudiating anything from the signs of God.

key_terms.دين: Religion, way of life, faith commitment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about those who have no religion?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) declared three categories of people who have no valid religion: those who follow leaders who disobey God, those who attribute lies to God, and those who deny any of God's signs. This hadith from al-Amali of al-Mufid establishes fundamental principles of religious legitimacy in Shia thought, particularly the obligation to follow only righteous, divinely authorized leadership rather than unjust rulers.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
